Commands.Description: Run this macro with LOOP. Each loop reads one CSV row.

Commands.Target: const data = { empresa: '${!COL1}', actividad: '${!COL2}', puesto: '${!COL3}', nivel: '${!COL4}', area: '${!COL5}', subarea: '${!COL6}', pais: '${!COL7}', mesInicio: '${!COL8}', anoInicio: '${!COL9}', mesFin: '${!COL10}', anoFin: '${!COL11}', detalle: '${!COL12}', personasACargo: '${!COL13}', presupuesto: '${!COL14}' }; const sleep = ms => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const textOf = el => (el && el.textContent ? el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : ''); const fire = (el, type) => el.dispatchEvent(new Event(type, { bubbles: true })); const setNativeValue = (selector, value) => { const el = document.querySelector(selector); if (!el) throw new Error('Missing field: ' + selector); const proto = el.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ? window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype : window.HTMLInputElement.prototype; const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto, 'value').set; setter.call(el, value || ''); fire(el, 'input'); fire(el, 'change'); fire(el, 'blur'); }; const findOption = label => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[id*="-option-"], .select__option, [role="option"]')).find(el => textOf(el) === label); const selectReact = async (containerId, label, index = 0) => { if (!label) return; const roots = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[id="' + containerId + '"]')); const root = roots[index]; if (!root) throw new Error('Missing select: ' + containerId + '[' + index + ']'); const input = root.querySelector('input'); const control = root.querySelector('.select__control') || root; control.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window })); control.click(); await sleep(250); if (input && !input.readOnly && !input.disabled) { input.focus(); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(input, label); fire(input, 'input'); fire(input, 'change'); await sleep(500); } let option = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { option = findOption(label); if (option) break; await sleep(200); } if (!option) throw new Error('Missing option: ' + containerId + '[' + index + '] -> ' + label); option.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window })); option.click(); await sleep(250); }; window.__laborumFillDone = false; window.__laborumFillError = ''; (async () => { try { setNativeValue('#empresa', data.empresa); setNativeValue('#puesto', data.puesto); await selectReact('select-actividad', data.actividad); await selectReact('select-nivel', data.nivel); await selectReact('select-area', data.area); await sleep(800); await selectReact('select-subarea', data.subarea); await selectReact('select-pais', data.pais); await selectReact('month', data.mesInicio, 0); await selectReact('year', data.anoInicio, 0); await selectReact('month', data.mesFin, 1); await selectReact('year', data.anoFin, 1); setNativeValue('#detalle', data.detalle); setNativeValue('#personasACargo', data.personasACargo); const presupuesto = document.querySelector('input[name="presupuesto"][value="' + data.presupuesto + '"]'); if (presupuesto) presupuesto.click(); window.__laborumFillDone = true; } catch (err) { window.__laborumFillError = err.message || String(err); window.__laborumFillDone = true; } })();
